maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is premiums from auto, home and business owners insurance, not repair or maintenance of installed products.

publicly_funded.reason: Premiums are paid by private drivers, homeowners and businesses in Massachusetts, New Hampshire and Maine, not by government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by writing policies through independent agents in its home states, not by regular acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Personal auto and home policies can be moved to another carrier fairly easily, though auto cover is legally required.

notes: Mission-critical is a judgement call, since auto insurance is mandatory but carriers are easy to change.
